adjudication.rationale: The diff changes the generic Calendar interface to require `createEvent(event: CalendarEvent, credentialId: number)` in `packages/types/Calendar.d.ts`, and `CalendarManager.createEvent` now always calls `calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)`. In this diff, the new `credentialId` argument is only used by `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent` to select the correct destination calendar (`destinationCalendar.find(cal => cal.credentialId === credentialId)`), while other calendar services (e.g., Lark/Office365) continue to treat destination calendar as a single/first element and don't need credential-based selection. This supports the finding as an architectural/scope concern: a Google-specific selection mechanism is pushed into the shared interface rather than resolving the destination/externalId before calling the provider service.
